product: Budget alerts can now trigger webhooks (Beta)
tagline: You can now configure budgets to trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are exhausted, so budget events can be routed to incident, ticketing, or automation tools.
what_it_does: You can now configure budgets to trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are exhausted, so budget events can be routed to incident, ticketing, or automation tools. This article explains how to use budgets to track spending in your Databricks account. Budgets enable you to monitor usage across your account.
why_it_matters: Workspace admins can create and manage budgets scoped to workspaces they administer using Governance Hub.
plain_summary: You can now configure budgets to trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are exhausted, so budget events can be routed to incident, ticketing, or automation tools.
